config.label: Progressive tool discovery
config.description: Progressive tool discovery. Left on, tools/list advertises five discovery meta-tools and the rest become callable once a category is activated (~828 tokens on connect). Set to false to advertise all 1,677 up front (~154,000).

config.label: Token ceiling for the schemas a session may have active at once
config.description: Token ceiling for the schemas a session may have active at once.

config.label: Colon-separated allowlist of directories the server may read
config.description: Colon-separated allowlist of directories the server may read. Any app_path outside them is refused.

config.label: Enables session-token authentication
config.description: Enables session-token authentication. Unset, authentication is off.

config.label: Client-side token, required only once SYMFONY_MCP_SESSION_SECRET is set
config.description: Client-side token, required only once SYMFONY_MCP_SESSION_SECRET is set.

config.label: Encrypted audit log of every tool call
config.description: Encrypted audit log of every tool call.

config.label: Scan every result for credentials before returning it
config.description: Scan every result for credentials before returning it. Turning this off is reported as CRITICAL by the startup audit.
